STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast tray with several items: a fried egg, a English muffin sandwich (appears to contain ham/cheese), sliced avocado, a juice glass, a water glass, a milk bottle, a yogurt cup, a bowl of flake cereal, and a banana on a side plate. Photographed from a fairly high, near-frontal angle.

STEP 2 - Ruler: Main plate is a paper plate roughly 22 cm diameter (area ≈ 380 cm²). Cereal bowl ≈ 15 cm (area ≈ 177 cm²). Banana side plate ≈ 17 cm (area ≈ 227 cm²). Only the items on the main plate, cereal bowl, and tray are counted as this meal; the banana is on its own plate and is included as part of the meal.

STEP 3 - Items: fried egg, English muffin with ham/cheese, avocado slices, cornflakes-style cereal, banana, yogurt (small cup, ~150 g), milk (glass bottle, ~150 ml visible), orange juice (~200 ml), water (~200 ml, negligible energy).

- Cereal bowl (177 cm²): cereal fills ~80% (142 cm²) at ~2 cm height.
- Banana plate: banana ~25% of plate (57 cm²) at ~3 cm volume envelope.

- Cereal (dry flakes): 142 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 284 ml × 0.3 ≈ 85 g dry, with a little milk; counted as dry weight.
- Banana: ~120 g peeled (medium banana, size fits plate).
- Yogurt: ~150 g cup.

- Water: ~200 g (0 kcal).

- Avocado: 35 g × 160 = 56 kcal

- Water: 200 g × 0 = 0 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 1,070 g of food and drink, ~1,068 kcal. This is plausible for a full breakfast tray with generous portions.
